test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined part of the given sentence.

Dogs are known for possession of __the quality of being faithful.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fidelity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Being faithful indicates loyalty and steadfastness. (वफादारी)
 
 
• **Example:** Dogs are known for their exceptional faithfulness to their owners.
 
 
 
• Fidelity means faith
